data.title: Liquid-filled suspended-core fibers for flat and broadband supercontinuum generation
data.author: Bao Tran Le Tran, Khoa Dinh Xuan, Dung Nguyen Tien, Thuan Binh Dinh, Thuy Do Thanh, Vinh Doan The Ngo, Trung Le Canh
data.summary: This work introduces a dispersion engineering technology for supercontinuum (SC) generation based on liquid-infiltrated suspended core fibers (SCFs), enabling efficient spectral control without modifying the fiber geometry. An SCF structure with air holes is filled with water, demonstrating a flat anomalous dispersion in a wide wavelength range. For coherent SC generation, an ethanol-filled fiber with the same core diameter of 1.7 µm is considered to shift the dispersion curves toward the normal dispersion region. The resulting dispersion profiles show good agreement between numerical simulations and experimental data. The generalized nonlinear Schrödinger equation (GNLSE) is subsequently employed to investigate the influence of pump pulse parameters on SC evolution. The simulations investigate how SC changes with pump peak power and pulse width in a 10 cm fiber when pumped at a wavelength of 1030 nm. A broadening of the SC spectrum is observed as the pump peak power at a wavelength of 1030 nm rises from 5 to 30 kW. The same trend persists for shorter pulse widths, ranging from 200 to 50 fs. Notably, the proposed water-filled SCF generates a broad spectrum spanning from 674 to 1918 nm in the anomalous regimes. Meanwhile, the generation of a flat SC spectrum from 757 to 1400 nm is obtained in the all-normal dispersion ethanol-filled fiber. These findings demonstrate the effectiveness of liquid infiltration as an experimentally accessible tool for dispersion control in SCFs, and provide new insights for infrared SC sources.
data.title_cn: 用于产生扁平和宽带超连续谱的液体填充悬芯光纤
data.abstract_cn: 这项工作介绍了一种基于液体渗透悬浮芯光纤（SCF）的超连续谱（SC）产生的色散工程技术，无需修改光纤几何形状即可实现高效的光谱控制。带有气孔的 SCF 结构充满了水，在很宽的波长范围内表现出平坦的反常色散。对于相干 SC 生成，具有相同芯直径 1.7 µm 的乙醇填充光纤被认为可将色散曲线移向正常色散区域。所得的色散分布显示数值模拟和实验数据之间具有良好的一致性。随后采用广义非线性薛定谔方程（GNLSE）来研究泵浦脉冲参数对 SC 演化的影响。该模拟研究了在 10 cm 光纤中以 1030 nm 波长泵浦时 SC 如何随泵浦峰值功率和脉冲宽度变化。当 1030 nm 波长处的泵浦峰值功率从 5 kW 上升到 30 kW 时，观察到 SC 光谱变宽。对于较短的脉冲宽度（范围为 200 至 50 fs），同样的趋势仍然存在。值得注意的是，所提出的充水 SCF 在异常状态下产生从 674 到 1918 nm 的宽光谱。同时，在全正向分散乙醇填充光纤中获得了从757 nm到1400 nm的平坦SC光谱。这些发现证明了液体渗透作为超临界流体扩散控制的实验可用工具的有效性，并为红外超临界光源提供了新的见解。

data.title: Hybrid spatial manipulation method on the high-power stimulated Brillouin amplification beam combining system
data.author: Can Cui, Yue Wang, Yongkang Dong, Yulei Wang, Zhiwei Lü
data.summary: Laser beam combining based on stimulated Brillouin amplification (SBA) promises numerous applications, since it can not only boost the power of the pulsed laser from multi-pump energy transfer but also permit the active spatial intensity manipulation process for the diverse-targeted beam profile, such as a square or round flat-top beam. In this paper, in order to further enhance the output laser beam intensity, a hybrid spatial manipulation method, which combines the structure and beam intensity optimization, has been proposed for the first time, to our knowledge. Based on the simulation results of the SBA beam combining models, a round flat-top combined output with a spatial intensity modulation index of M =1.42 is realized from an initially Gaussian beam profile experimentally. Simultaneously, the peak intensity, from initially 200MW/cm 2 to exceeding 1GW/cm 2 , was obtained in the five-beam-combining system, with the combining efficiency reaching 78.5%. This hybrid manipulation method paved the way for practical application of SBA beam combining systems towards tens-of-joule-level repetitive nanosecond laser pulse output in the field of material processing and petawatt laser pumping, etc.
data.title_cn: 高功率受激布里渊放大合束系统混合空间操纵方法
data.abstract_cn: 基于受激布里渊放大（SBA）的激光束组合有望获得广泛的应用，因为它不仅可以通过多泵浦能量转移提高脉冲激光的功率，而且还可以对不同目标光束轮廓（例如方形或圆形平顶光束）进行主动空间强度操纵过程。在本文中，为了进一步提高输出激光束强度，据我们所知，首次提出了一种将结构和光束强度优化相结合的混合空间操纵方法。基于SBA合束模型的仿真结果，实验性地从初始高斯光束轮廓实现了空间强度调制指数M=1.42的圆形平顶合束输出。同时，五光束合束系统的峰值强度从最初的200MW/cm 2 提高到超过1GW/cm 2 ，合束效率达到78.5%。这种混合操纵方法为SBA合束系统在材料加工和拍瓦激光泵浦等领域实现数十焦耳级重复纳秒激光脉冲输出的实际应用铺平了道路。

data.title: Compact monolithic high-power narrow-linewidth multi-wavelength DFB laser array for optical I/O applications
data.author: Yue Zhang, Shenghong Xie, Zhenxing Sun, Rulei Xiao, Yuechun Shi, Xiangfei Chen
data.summary: We propose and experimentally demonstrate a compact monolithic four-wavelength distributed feedback (DFB) laser array with 300 GHz spacing, featuring high output power and excellent power uniformity. The lasers are connected in parallel, and a two-stage Y-branch combiner efficiently merges the four wavelengths. An integrated semiconductor optical amplifier (SOA) further boosts the output power. The reconstruction equivalent chirp (REC) technique enables precise wavelength control, while the slab-coupled optical waveguide (SCOW) structure minimizes internal losses and maintains single-mode operation under a wider ridge waveguide. Anti-reflection (AR) and high-reflection (HR) coatings are applied to enhance output efficiency. Experimental results show output powers exceeding 100 mW per wavelength, wavelength deviation below 0.039 nm, side-mode suppression ratios above 35 dB, and linewidths under 530 kHz. The relative intensity noise (RIN) remains below −145 dB/Hz, and clear 25 Gb/s NRZ eye diagrams are obtained using an external LiNbO 3 Mach–Zehnder modulator. These results confirm the proposed laser array as a promising high-power, narrow-linewidth, and power-balanced light source for DWDM optical I/O applications.
data.title_cn: 适用于光学 I/O 应用的紧凑型单片高功率窄线宽多波长 DFB 激光器阵列
data.abstract_cn: 我们提出并通过实验演示了一种间距为 300 GHz 的紧凑型单片四波长分布式反馈 (DFB) 激光器阵列，具有高输出功率和出色的功率均匀性。激光器并联连接，两级 Y 分支组合器有效地合并四个波长。集成半导体光放大器 (SOA) 进一步提高了输出功率。重构等效线性调频 (REC) 技术可实现精确的波长控制，而平板耦合光波导 (SCOW) 结构可最大限度地减少内部损耗，并在更宽的脊形波导下保持单模操作。采用增透膜（AR）和高反射​​膜（HR）来提高输出效率。实验结果表明，每个波长的输出功率超过100 mW，波长偏差低于0.039 nm，边模抑制比高于35 dB，线宽低于530 kHz。相对强度噪声 (RIN) 保持在 -145 dB/Hz 以下，并且使用外部 LiNbO 3 Mach-Zehnder 调制器获得清晰的 25 Gb/s NRZ 眼图。这些结果证实了所提出的激光阵列是一种有前景的高功率、窄线宽和功率平衡光源，适用于 DWDM 光学 I/O 应用。

data.title: Fully planar high-order frequency selective surface with quasi-elliptical response using multimodal structure
data.author: Zhenlin Li, Yin Li, Ruixiang Liao, Sai-Wai Wong, Ming Fu, Ying Mei, Hao Chen, Muhammad Rizwan Anjum
data.summary: We propose and experimentally demonstrate a fully planar high-order frequency selective surface (FSS) based on multimode resonators (MMRs) with a quasi-elliptic bandpass response characterized by finite-frequency transmission zeros near the passband edges. In our design, these TZs are realized by implementing cross-coupling paths synthesized and guided by a coupling-matrix formulation. The proposed unit cell adopts a resonator–dual-mode–resonator configuration, functioning as a high-order filter low profile, and high selectivity. Coupling-matrix theory is further employed to elucidate the operating mechanism and to analyze the transmission and reflection characteristics, indicating that the filtering performance can be improved by increasing the resonator order and the number of coupling paths. A planar prototype is fabricated and measured, exhibiting four transmission poles and two transmission zeros in good agreement with simulations. The structure achieves a 3-dB fractional bandwidth (FBW) of 11.5% with an overall thickness of only 0.14 λ 0 , while maintaining low insertion loss and enabling simple, low-cost fabrication.
data.title_cn: 使用多模态结构的具有准椭圆响应的全平面高阶频率选择表面
data.abstract_cn: 我们提出并通过实验证明了一种基于多模谐振器（MMR）的全平面高阶频率选择表面（FSS），其具有准椭圆带通响应，其特征在于通带边缘附近的有限频率传输零点。在我们的设计中，这些 TZ 是通过实现由耦合矩阵公式合成和引导的交叉耦合路径来实现的。所提出的单元采用谐振器-双模谐振器配置，充当高阶滤波器，外形小，选择性高。进一步利用耦合矩阵理论阐明了其工作机制并分析了传输和反射特性，表明可以通过增加谐振器阶数和耦合路径数量来提高滤波性能。制作并测量了平面原型，其具有四个传输极点和两个传输零点，与仿真非常吻合。该结构实现了 11.5% 的 3dB 分数带宽 (FBW)，总厚度仅为 0.14 λ 0 ，同时保持低插入损耗并实现简单、低成本的制造。

data.title: Design and verification of a hyperspectral instrument for atmospheric and water optical properties observations
data.author: Xinhao Shi, Shuguo Chen
data.summary: Long-term, continuous in-situ observations of atmospheric and water optical properties are crucial for understanding the impacts of climate change, revealing pathways of atmospheric material transport, and studying air-sea interactions. For ocean color satellite sensors, sustained in-situ measurements are crucial in supporting their on-orbit calibration, the validation of high-level data products, and the development of data processing algorithms. This study presents what we believe to be a novel autonomous instrument called the hyperspectral sun photometer (HSP) designed for long-term, continuous, and synchronous measurement of atmospheric and water optical properties. The HSP delivers measurements across the 400–1020 nm spectral range with a spectral resolution of 1 nm. The performance of the HSP was evaluated through comparative observations with the CE-318 T sun photometer. The results demonstrate that within the visible spectrum, the HSP and CE-318 T achieve consistent results at common wavelengths: the discrepancy in aerosol optical depth (AOD) is within 7%, while the maximum difference in water-leaving radiance is only 4.74% at 667 nm. The temporal stability of HSP observations for different targets verifies its operational robustness. In summary, the HSP can serve as a stable instrument for the synchronous in-situ measurement of atmospheric and water optical properties.
data.title_cn: 大气和水光学特性观测高光谱仪器的设计与验证
data.abstract_cn: 对大气和水光学特性的长期、连续现场观测对于了解气候变化的影响、揭示大气物质传输路径以及研究海气相互作用至关重要。对于海洋颜色卫星传感器来说，持续的原位测量对于支持其在轨校准、高级数据产品的验证以及数据处理算法的开发至关重要。这项研究提出了我们认为是一种新型自主仪器，称为高光谱太阳光度计（HSP），专为长期、连续、同步测量大气和水的光学特性而设计。 HSP 可在 400–1020 nm 光谱范围内进行测量，光谱分辨率为 1 nm。通过与CE-318 T太阳光度计的比较观察来评估HSP的性能。结果表明，在可见光谱范围内，HSP和CE-318 T在共同波长下取得了一致的结果：气溶胶光学深度（AOD）差异在7%以内，而出水辐射率在667 nm处的最大差异仅为4.74%。不同目标的 HSP 观测的时间稳定性验证了其操作稳健性。综上所述，HSP可以作为大气和水光学特性同步原位测量的稳定仪器。

data.title: Ultrafast laser-induced refractive index tuning inside GeSbSNa glasses for mid-IR applications
data.author: Heng Yao, Julien Ari, Diego Pugliese, Marc Dussauze, Jianrong Qiu, Matthieu Lancry
data.summary: Femtosecond laser direct writing (FLDW) enables precise, three-dimensional (3D) structuring within transparent materials, offering a versatile platform for integrated photonics. In this work, we investigate the photo-response of sodium-doped GeSbS (GeSbSNa) chalcogenide glasses under femtosecond laser irradiation, a system of interest for mid-infrared (MIR) applications yet largely unexplored. Through quantitative phase microscopy, we extract refractive index changes as a function of composition and laser pulse energy, achieving phase shifts up to 62 radians and refractive index contrasts ( Δn ) exceeding 0.05—among the highest reported for chalcogenide systems. Raman spectroscopy reveals localized structural reorganizations, notably a transition from corner- to edge-sharing GeS 4 tetrahedra, consistent with laser-induced densification. We also evaluate the thermal stability of the modifications via isochronal annealing and compare them with commercial glass benchmarks. Overall, these results provide a quantitative basis for assessing GeSbSNa glasses as prospective materials for MIR photonic integration, particularly in contexts where both high photosensitivity and moderate thermal durability are desirable, even though no specific devices are demonstrated here.
data.title_cn: 用于中红外应用的 GeSbSNa 玻璃内超快激光诱导折射率调谐
data.abstract_cn: 飞秒激光直写 (FLDW) 可在透明材料内实现精确的三维 (3D) 结构，为集成光子学提供多功能平台。在这项工作中，我们研究了钠掺杂 GeSbS (GeSbSNa) 硫系玻璃在飞秒激光照射下的光响应，这是一个对中红外 (MIR) 应用感兴趣的系统，但在很大程度上尚未开发。通过定量相位显微镜，我们提取了作为成分和激光脉冲能量函数的折射率变化，实现了高达 62 弧度的相移和超过 0.05 的折射率对比度 ( Δn )，这是硫族化物系统报道的最高值之​​一。拉曼光谱揭示了局部结构重组，特别是从共享角到共享边的 GeS 4 四面体的转变，与激光诱导致密化一致。我们还通过等时退火评估改性的热稳定性，并将其与商业玻璃基准进行比较。总体而言，这些结果为评估 GeSbSNa 玻璃作为中红外光子集成的前景材料提供了定量基础，特别是在需要高光敏性和中等耐热性的情况下，尽管这里没有演示具体的器件。

data.title: Approximate thumbnail-preserving encryption based on single-pixel imaging
data.author: Daili Wang, Dongming Huo, Yi Wei, Zongguang Ouyang, Ying Li, Yu Kou, Chao Yang, Zhenghua Hu, Sheng Yuan, Xin Zhou
data.summary: With the rapid development of smart devices and Internet technology, the volume of visual data stored in the cloud has increased dramatically, posing severe challenges to security and privacy protection. Traditional image encryption methods often produce encrypted images that are difficult to view, preventing users from previewing content in the cloud. Thumbnail-preserving encryption (TPE) enables encrypted images to retain visual features, thereby striking a balance between security and usability. Most thumbnail-preserving encryption schemes employ complex pixel-wise encryption operations, which often suffer from long encryption times, low perceptual quality of the encrypted images, and a high file expansion rate of the encrypted image. This paper proposes an approximate thumbnail-preserving encryption scheme based on single-pixel imaging, referred to as TPE-SPI. The scheme utilizes the bucket signals, speckle patterns, and the pixel values of the target image, along with the relationships among them, to achieve efficient and secure thumbnail-preserving encryption through simple processing of the bucket signals. Compared to other schemes, TPE-SPI offers higher encryption efficiency and better visual quality of the encrypted image, while effectively reducing the file expansion rate of the encrypted image.
data.title_cn: 基于单像素成像的近似缩略图保留加密
data.abstract_cn: 随着智能设备和互联网技术的快速发展，云端存储的视觉数据量急剧增加，对安全和隐私保护提出了严峻的挑战。传统的图像加密方法通常会产生难以查看的加密图像，从而阻止用户预览云端内容。缩略图保留加密 (TPE) 使加密图像能够保留视觉特征，从而在安全性和可用性之间取得平衡。大多数缩略图保留加密方案采用复杂的逐像素加密操作，其往往存在加密时间长、加密图像的感知质量低以及加密图像的文件扩展率高的问题。本文提出一种基于单像素成像的近似缩略图保留加密方案，简称TPE-SPI。该方案利用桶信号、散斑图案和目标图像的像素值以及它们之间的关系，通过对桶信号的简单处理来实现高效、安全的缩略图保留加密。与其他方案相比，TPE-SPI提供了更高的加密效率和更好的加密图像视觉质量，同时有效降低了加密图像的文件扩展率。

data.title: Over 300 mW O-band 8-channel DFB laser array for optical I/O technology
data.author: Shenghong Xie, Bocang Qiu, Zhenxing Sun, Yinyin Hu, Yining Liang, Tongtong Yang, Feng Wang, Lianping Hou, Xiangfei Chen, Yuechun Shi
data.summary: A high-power distributed feedback laser array suitable for optical I/O applications is demonstrated. The epitaxial structure incorporates a high-refractive-index layer in the N-doped region to improve single-transverse-mode characteristics and reduce internal loss, enabling single-mode operation at a ridge width of 5 µm with an internal loss of 3 cm -1 . An asymmetric π-phase-shift, implemented using the reconstruction-equivalent chirp technique, ensures high single-mode yield. The fabricated array achieves output powers above 300 mW per channel at 25 °C with 800 mA injection current and exhibits uniform channel spacing with side mode suppression ratios exceeding 50 dB. Stable single-longitudinal-mode operation is maintained without mode hopping over a broad current and temperature tuning range. Under simultaneous operation at an injection current of 300 mA per channel, all channels of the laser array deliver output powers exceeding 100 mW, with an average wavelength deviation of 0.0692 nm. The devices further show a minimum Lorentzian linewidth of 300 kHz, and relative intensity noise of –154 dB/Hz, demonstrating strong potential for high-speed optical interconnects.
data.title_cn: 用于光学 I/O 技术的超过 300 mW O 波段 8 通道 DFB 激光阵列
data.abstract_cn: 演示了适用于光学 I/O 应用的高功率分布式反馈激光器阵列。该外延结构在N掺杂区域中加入了高折射率层，以改善单横模特性并降低内部损耗，使得单模工作在脊宽为5 µm的情况下，内部损耗为3 cm -1 。使用重构等效线性调频技术实现的非对称 π 相移可确保高单模产量。所制造的阵列在 25°C 下以 800 mA 注入电流实现每通道 300 mW 以上的输出功率，并表现出均匀的通道间距，边模抑制比超过 50 dB。在宽电流和温度调谐范围内保持稳定的单纵模运行，无需进行模式跳跃。在每通道注入电流300 mA的同时工作下，激光器阵列的所有通道输出功率超过100 mW，平均波长偏差为0.0692 nm。该器件还显示出 300 kHz 的最小洛伦兹线宽和 –154 dB/Hz 的相对强度噪声，展示了高速光学互连的强大潜力。

data.title: Efficient angle-resolved transfer-matrix method incorporating Gaussian roughness for THz multilayers
data.author: Hossein Ghani, Mehdi Ahmadi-Boroujeni
data.summary: We present the efficient angle-resolved rough-surface transfer-matrix method (RS-TMM). This compact formulation involves Gaussian roughness statistics and k z -dependent attenuation factors explicitly in the (2 × 2) interface matrices. The entire multilayer stack can subsequently be solved in a single matrix product, and the formulation analytically recovers the smooth-surface limit as σ r → 0. The formulation preserves the algebraic clarity, numerical stability, and O ( N ) computational complexity of classical matrix optics, while eliminating the need for per-layer parameter tracking, meshing, and iterative solvers. The method’s analytical consistency is validated by proving its algebraic equivalence to the recursive Green-function formulation within the Rayleigh domain. For frequencies 0.1-1 THz and root-mean-square surface roughness σ r ≤60μm, the model agrees closely with recursive-method benchmarks. Running in milliseconds on a laptop, RS–TMM enables frequency-, angle-, and material-parameter sweeps for real-time indoor THz links and imaging.
data.title_cn: 结合高斯粗糙度的太赫兹多层的高效角度分辨传递矩阵方法
data.abstract_cn: 我们提出了高效的角度解析粗糙表面传递矩阵方法（RS-TMM）。这个紧凑的公式涉及高斯粗糙度统计和 (2 × 2) 界面矩阵中明确的 k z 相关衰减因子。随后可以在单个矩阵乘积中求解整个多层堆叠，并且该公式通过分析将光滑表面极限恢复为 σ r → 0。该公式保留了经典矩阵光学的代数清晰度、数值稳定性和 O ( N ) 计算复杂性，同时消除了对每层参数跟踪、网格划分和迭代求解器的需要。通过证明其与瑞利域内递归格林函数公式的代数等价性，验证了该方法的分析一致性。对于频率 0.1-1 THz 和均方根表面粗糙度 σ r ≤60μm，该模型与递归方法基准非常一致。 RS–TMM 在笔记本电脑上以毫秒为单位运行，可实现频率、角度和材料参数扫描，以实现实时室内太赫兹链路和成像。

data.title: Excitation of Spin Waves in Ferrimagnetic Alloy via Optical Transient Grating Spectroscopy
data.author: Marta Brioschi, Pietro Carrara, Nupur Ninad Khatu, Nadia Berndt, Peter R. Miedaner, Deepak Dagur, Giovanni Vinai, Dieter Engel, Clemens von Korff Schmising, Stefano Bonetti, Keith Adam Nelson, Giancarlo Panaccione, Giorgio Rossi, Alexei A. Maznev, Riccardo Cucini
data.summary: The investigation of spin waves provides fundamental insights into magnetic materials and is essential for advancing spintronic and magnonic technologies. The Transient Grating (TG) technique, a four‐wave mixing method, has been widely used to study collective excitations at controlled wave vectors on the micron to nanometer scale. This study presents an all‐optical TG approach for exciting standing dipolar spin waves with a controlled in‐plane wave vector in a ferrimagnetic Co 78 Gd 22 thin film, with potential applicability to a broad range of materials. Spin waves with a wavelength of 2.5 μm are excited by the interference of two coherent laser pulses on the sample surface and probed through the diffraction of a third laser pulse. Polarization analysis separates magnetic and thermoelastic signals and enables time‐resolved measurements of the spin‐wave dynamics.
data.title_cn: 通过光学瞬态光栅光谱激发亚铁磁合金中的自旋波
data.abstract_cn: 自旋波的研究提供了对磁性材料的基本见解，对于推进自旋电子和磁波技术至关重要。瞬态光栅（TG）技术是一种四波混频方法，已广泛用于研究微米到纳米尺度上受控波矢量的集体激发。这项研究提出了一种全光学热重法，用于在亚铁磁性 Co 78 Gd 22 薄膜中激发具有受控面内波矢量的偶极自旋驻波，具有广泛材料的潜在适用性。波长为 2.5 μm 的自旋波由样品表面上两个相干激光脉冲的干涉激发，并通过第三个激光脉冲的衍射进行探测。偏振分析可分离磁信号和热弹性信号，并实现自旋波动力学的时间分辨测量。
